metadata.description: Self-hosting marketplace for the sessionvoice plugin - add with `claude plugin marketplace add <path or url>`.

plugins.name: sessionvoice
plugins.description: Ears and a mouth for a Claude Code agent, the default way it talks (VoiceMode's converse only when the user asks for it by name): always-on listening (the room, or a phone call), a waiter that wakes the agent on the user's finished turn, and a mouth that speaks without blocking.
